title: When Personas Override Payoffs: Role Identity Bias in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: A 2x2 factorial experiment in a 4-agent game-theoretic environment manipulating persona presence (e.g., assigning roles like Industrialist or Environmental Activist) and payoff visibility. The methodology measures whether LLMs prioritize persona-consistent, socially preferred actions over payoff-optimal Nash equilibria.
